take: i2: v2c's body (bars 9-32 and 35-45, re-rendered by inpainting), i1's rebirth (bars 1-5), the drop (6-8) and access (33-34) regenerated; plus our soft kick, the bars 1-4 rise and the bars 31-33 rebuild

kick.note: synthesised soft kick tuned to A1; each section's kicks sit on the take's own pulse (unchanged by the fixes: the drums stem is bit-identical)

beatDeviationMs.method: our kicks against the film's 0.500 s grid (they follow the take's pulse); the take's own pulse per section is in pulsePhaseMs

pulseNote: Bars 31-32 (60-64 s) now carry the access groove's pulse (+32 ms, the rebuild layer); bar 30 keeps the take's (-11 ms). Kept from before the fixes, because the riser masks the onsets now: 0.0-8.0 s (contrast now 1.74, before the riser 3.54).

rebirth.method: the bass eased 7.5 dB down after the bar-1 hit (0.15-0.45 s) and back to 0 dB at 7.5 s; a soft noise riser made here (band centre 250 Hz to 3 kHz, +30 dB over 0.3-7.6 s, ending 3.0 dB under the music); everything stops dead at 7.6 s, 24 f before bar 5
rebirth.measure: K-weighted, ungated: bar 1 beat 2 (0.5-1.0 s) against the end of bar 4 (7.1-7.5 s)

rebuild.method: the take's own access groove (bar 34, the other stem) tiled on the bar lines from bar 31 beat 1 (20 ms crossfades), rising from -10 dB to -1 dB at bar 33 beat 1 and 0 dB at bar 33 beat 3, where the take's own groove takes over (60 ms)

shaker.note: a soft shaker synthesised here on every eighth, the off-beats 4 dB louder, on the kick's pulse; in the drums stem

drive.note: for the owner to compare; the same music as act2-v2.wav plus the shaker

notes: Built 2026-11-10 to the lead's bar map. Three full takes (v2a, v2b, v2c) all put 8-10 s of silence where the rebirth should be (the first chunk's text mentioned a silent last bar) and v2a/v2b were off key (C minor, G major) and off the map; v2c (A minor, map rho 0.56) became the base. Inpainting (music_v2_5 composition plan with audio-reference chunks) regenerated the rebirth (i1) and then the drop and the access bars (i2, without conditioning); the model kept them kick-less, and stem separation found no drums at all (drums stem -128 dB): the take is bass plus synths. So a soft kick synthesised here (55 Hz, A1) was added in the drop, the solution groove with bar 22, access and the lift, on the take's own pulse. Conform: bar 1's hit moved to 0.000 s (-21.2 ms), hard mutes at 7.6-10.0, 33.5-34.0, 53.5-54.5 and 76.0-80.0 s, a fade to silence 87-90 s; no time-stretch (tempo fit 119.98 BPM, 0.016% from 120). Entries land on the grid: drop 10.003 s, groove 33.991 s, resolve 54.502 s, end chord 80.004 s. The take's pulse sits -13 to +32 ms from the grid depending on the section (the model starts regenerated chunks on their own phase); visual hits on the grid may lead the music by up to about 30 ms in the drop, access, lift and strip-back. Stems: drums = our kick (the separated drums are silent); other = bass + other + piano (+ silent guitar and vocals); full - (drums + other) = -65 dB. Speech: no vocals stem content. Fixes (the lead, 2026-11-10, second round): bars 1-4 now climb 7.7 dB into bar 4 (see rebirth), and bars 31-32 rebuild into bar 33's kick instead of thinning to -45 LUFS (bars 30-33 now -25.7, -23.8, -20.6, -16.5 LUFS). Mutes, bar lines and kicks unchanged. A drive variant (variants.drive) adds a soft tuned shaker for the owner to compare; it is not in MUSIC_FILES.
